newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Portugal seeks to buy maize into public stores.
newsitem.headline: Portugal seeks to buy maize into public stores.

text.p: A Portuguese request to allow it to buy maize into intervention will on Thursday be considered by the European Union's cereals management committee, an EU official said on Tuesday.
"The Portuguese have made a request to allow their intervention board to buy maize on the open market," the official said.
The item is listed for a possible vote following decisions on the normal rice and cereals export tenders, standing refunds and correctives at an otherwise routine meeting.
